description:
Essential Job Functions:


- Build hybrid iOS/Android applications with Swift/Java, JavaScript (Ember), CSS3, and HTML5


- Work in a cross discipline agile team to build compelling desktop and mobile user experiences


Requirements:


- 3 years experience building/deploying mobile applications.


- You have iOS and/or Android native development experience


- Working knowledge of HTML5/CSS3


- Strong code hygiene and automated unit testing experience


- Experience developing in an agile development environment


- You know advanced Git techniques and workflows -


Excellent communication skills


Ideal Candidate:


- 3+ years experience building/deploying mobile applications.


- Experience with continuous integration using NodeJS and Gradle


- Experience debugging applications for cross-browser and mobile perfection


- Experience developing in a Unix based environment


- Desire to push the boundaries 



 Skill :  HTML5/CSS3, NodeJS and Gradle


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
